name: Choice Overload
axiom: Too many comparable options stall decisions and leave people less satisfied with what they choose.
trigger: A pricing page or settings screen shows many similar options and people stall, default, or leave without choosing.

checklist.text: Limit consumer pricing to three or four plans with visibly different value.
Mark one option as recommended so a default path through the comparison is obvious.
Move advanced filters and rare configurations behind progressive disclosure.

antiPattern.violation: A pricing table shows nine overlapping plans with no recommended option, and visitors leave without choosing.
antiPattern.remediation: Offer three clear tiers, mark one recommended, and route custom plans to a separate inquiry.

parametricParams.caption: MORE OPTIONS MAKE THE CHOICE HARDER

academicOrigin.title: When Choice Is Demotivating: Can One Desire Too Much of a Good Thing?
academicOrigin.publication: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 79(6), 995-1006
